# Keyboard Shortcuts Features
## Overview Your Social Bookmarking Site now has **HTMX-powered keyboard shortcuts** for faster navigation and productivity!
## Available Shortcuts
### Navigation Shortcuts - **`/`** - Focus search box (quickly access search) - **`N`** - Create new bookmark - **`A`** - View all bookmarks - **`M`** - View my bookmarks
### Form Shortcuts - **`Ctrl + S`** (Windows/Linux) or **`Cmd + S`** (Mac) - Submit forms - **`Esc`** - Close modals/dialogs
### Help - **`?`** - Show keyboard shortcuts help modal
## How to Use
### 1. Quick Search Press `/` anywhere on the page to focus the search box and immediately start typing your search query.
``` Press / → Start typing search term → Press Enter to search ```
### 2. Create Bookmark Press `N` to instantly navigate to the create bookmark form.
``` Press N → Fill form → Press Ctrl+S to submit ```
### 3. Switch Views - Press `A` to view all public bookmarks from all users - Press `M` to view only your personal bookmarks
### 4. Submit Forms Instead of clicking submit buttons, use `Ctrl+S` to submit any form on the page.
``` Fill form → Press Ctrl+S → Automatically submits ```
### 5. View Available Shortcuts Press `?` at any time to open the keyboard shortcuts help modal.
## Implementation Details
### Files Added 1. **`templates/keyboard_shortcuts.html`** - Contains: - Keyboard shortcuts modal dialog - All keyboard event handlers - Modal styling and interactions
### Files Modified 1. **`templates/base.html`** - Added: - Include statement for keyboard shortcuts template
2. **`templates/bookmark/bookmark_list.html`** - Added: - Help button (⌨️ Shortcuts) in header - ID for search input box
### Smart Features
✅ **Context-Aware** - Shortcuts don't trigger while typing in input fields ✅ **Modal Support** - Keyboard shortcuts work on all pages with the modal included ✅ **Click Outside** - Click outside modal to close it ✅ **Escape Key** - Press ESC to close modals ✅ **Cross-Browser** - Works on all modern browsers ✅ **Mobile Responsive** - Modal optimized for mobile devices
## Keyboard Event Logic
```javascript // Example: How '/' works - Check if user is typing in an input/textarea - If NOT typing: Focus search box and select text - If typing: Do nothing (allow normal '/' input)
// Example: How 'N' works - Find the create bookmark button - Redirect to create bookmark form ```
## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Press `/` and verify search box gets focus - [ ] Type a search query and press Enter - [ ] Press `?` to see the help modal - [ ] Press `Esc` to close the help modal - [ ] Click outside the modal to close it - [ ] Press `N` to navigate to create bookmark - [ ] Fill the form and press `Ctrl+S` to submit - [ ] Press `A` to view all bookmarks - [ ] Press `M` to view my bookmarks - [ ] Test on mobile device (should be responsive)
## Notes
- Shortcuts are **case-insensitive** for letter keys (A, M, N work as both uppercase and lowercase) - The `/` shortcut allows normal input when typing in the search box - All navigation shortcuts use standard `window.location.href` for instant navigation - Form submission uses the first form found on the page with `form.submit()`
## Future Enhancements
- Add more shortcuts (e.g., `I` for import, `P` for profile) - Add HTMX AJAX shortcuts for faster bookmark operations - Add shortcut customization panel - Add analytics to track most-used shortcuts
